name: Hiiragi Fuuka
source:
A young graphic designer who works on advertisements for famous companies. She doesn't have much experience with romance, nor with men, and is very conscious of her age.

She has other gods coming after her to try and use her for ulterior motives, but Aoi and Kouta are there to protect her.
